name: TWRREIT
recent: TWRREIT 于 2026 年 10 月 27 日召开第 14 届常年股东大会，所有决议均以投票方式通过，包括更新单位发行授权、增加现有单位总数，以及更新与 HLCM 和 GCA 的关联交易授权。公司也发布了截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩报告，并公布了每单位净资产值。此外，董事会于 8 月出现变动，Douglas Richard Fyvie Crichton 卸任。
notable: 第 14 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 10 月 27 日举行，所有决议均获通过。

recent_en: TWRREIT held its 14th Annual General Meeting on 27 October 2026, where all resolutions were passed by poll, including the renewal of the unit issuance mandate, an increase in the total number of units issued, and the renewal of the recurrent related party transaction mandate with HLCM and GCA. The company also released its quarterly consolidated results for the period ended 30 September 2026 and announced its net asset value per unit. In addition, there was a boardroom change in August with the departure of Douglas Richard Fyvie Crichton.
notable_en: The 14th Annual General Meeting was held on 27 October 2026 and all resolutions were passed.
Unitholders approved the renewal of the unit issuance mandate and an increase in the total number of units issued.
Unitholders approved the renewal of the recurrent related party transaction mandate with HLCM and GCA.
risks_en: The AGM approved an increase in the total number of units issued and renewed the unit issuance mandate, which may lead to unit dilution.
There was a boardroom change in August 2026 with the departure of Douglas Richard Fyvie Crichton.
